The last three bills (Aug 1,050.00, Sep 1,080.00, Oct 1,110.00) average 1,080.00, and every bill since May has been between 1,002.00 and 1,110.00. email_draft.subject: Invoice UTL-4412 – request for actual meter read (roastery meter)
email_draft.body:
Hello,

We received invoice UTL-4412 dated 2026-11-06 for 2,950.00 for electricity at our roastery meter. The invoice says it is based on an estimated read. Our recent monthly bills from you have been between 1,002.00 and 1,110.00, and the last three averaged 1,080.00. That makes this invoice about 1,870.00 higher than usual.

Please could you:
1. Confirm the meter reading and the estimate method used for this invoice.
2. Take an actual meter read, or accept one we provide, and send a corrected invoice if needed.
3. Confirm whether any back-billing or rate change is included.

We will hold this invoice until we hear from you.

Thank you,
Accounts Payable
